votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Larkin to approve Resolution No. 2024-014R tentatively adopting the FY 2024-25 City Manager Recommended Budget of the City of St. George and setting the public hearing dates for June 13, 2024 and June 20, 2024.
A motion was made by Councilmember Larsen to approve Resolution No. 2024-016R entering into an Interlocal Agreement with Washington County for the renovation of the Historic Dixie Sunbowl project.
votes.result: 5-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)

votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Larkin to approve Resolution No. 2024-017R entering into an Interlocal Agreement with the Washington County Water Conservancy District regarding the Red Hills Garden.
votes.result: 5-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)

votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Hughes to approve the Hillside Development permit to allow disturbance in over 20% slope areas to move the dirt from the Rosewood Townhomes site to Riverstone site, including the conditions from the Planning Commission to work with the long-term maintenance of the parcel.
votes.result: 5-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)

votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Kemp to approve Resolution No. 2024-015R entering into an Interlocal Cooperation Agreement between the City of St. George and the City of Santa Clara for a 69KV line.
votes.result: 5-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)

votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Larkin to approve Resolution No. 2024-013R to review and approve amendments to the Fiscal Year 2023-24 Budget.
A motion was made by Councilmember Larsen to adjourn.
votes.result: 5-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)
